rows: You hit hard. So what? A hard shot does not finish a match by itself.
You want me on the mat. Fair, and short. You will have to put me there.
Go up if you like. I will be waiting when you come down.
I came to wrestle. If you want to slow things down, you will have to stop me first.
They paid for a match. I do not intend to send anybody home feeling short-changed.
Not much to say. You paid to see me wrestle. Watch.
Right, then. Take the first one and tell me the same thing.
I can do the whole match. Can you?
Fine. Main event. Still got to wrestle me.
You have got your {strength}. I have got to find an answer. That is the job.
I heard you. I know what I have to deal with: {strength}. I am not pretending otherwise.
No shouting from me. Meet me when the bell goes.
Nothing against you. I need the win as much as you do.
I could stand here and have a row. Would not get us anywhere.
Same here. Let us get on with it.
That is not an answer. Have another go.
Hold on. Finish what you were saying.
Fair, and short. I will give you that.
You're good down there. I'm not giving you the takedown for nothing.
You hit hard, I know. I've still got a whole match to do.
Every jump ends on the mat. I'll be waiting there.
Don't spend the night leaning on the ropes. We've got work to do.
Nobody ought to go home thinking they paid for half a match.
I'm not going to give you a speech. I'll give you the wrestling.
Doesn't matter when I go on. I'll give them the main event's work.
This is what they're paying you to get past.
Keeping your feet is one thing. Keeping your balance is another.
Let's see what you say after you take one.
You've still got to get hold of me before I land.
There's a difference between wasting time and making you work.
I'll put the work in. You do the same.
It's a match, not a speech. Show me the grip.
Your {strength}. I'll have to get round that.
No use pretending those {strength} aren't there. I'll deal with them.
I've nothing against you. I've got a match to win.
I'll leave the shouting to someone else.
A row won't get either of us anywhere.
One fall, no fuss. Nobody else getting involved.
Fine. We can start down on the mat.
Stay on your feet with me. No flying off.
Stay inside the ropes and do your shift.
Fair, and short. We'll settle it properly.
You've not answered what I asked.
It'll be a proper hard match. I'm still going to win it.
I'll finish it. Simple as that.
Clean fall in the centre. Both of us do it properly.
I've done my preparation. No need to explain it here.
Can't back that up. Shouldn't have said it.
No example I can give you. Strike that bit.
Fine. Leave it out. We've got work to do.
Watch who gets the hold and who gets out. There's your answer.
They'll see whether either of us can finish the job. Nothing to make up there.
Never mind what someone's said. What can we show them by putting the work in?
We've got a match to do. What can they judge from that?
